```{r setup}
library(R.Final)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
```

This vignette guides through cleaning raw historical data from the NOAA Significant Earthquake Database and making static timelines and interactive maps.

## Data Preparation

The package includes data cleaning tools. `eq_clean_data()` fixes coordinates and handles year columns. `eq_location_clean()` removes out repetitive countries from the region names.

```{r data_prep}
# Read raw file safely using package contents
file_path <- system.file("extdata", "signif.txt", package = "R.Final")
raw_data <- readr::read_delim(file_path, delim = "\t")

# Apply cleaning functions
clean_data <- raw_data %>% 
  eq_clean_data() %>% 
  eq_location_clean()

head(clean_data %>% select(DATE, COUNTRY, LOCATION_NAME, EQ_PRIMARY))
```

## Visualizing Earthquakes with Custom Geoms

### 1. geom_timeline
The `geom_timeline()` function builds a horizontal time axis by grouping events vertically by structural criteria while styling size by magnitude and shade color by death.

```{r timeline_plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
clean_data %>% 
  filter(COUNTRY %in% c("USA", "CHINA"), YEAR >= 2010) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = DATE, y = COUNTRY, size = EQ_PRIMARY, color = TOTAL_DEATHS)) +
  geom_timeline() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### 2. geom_timeline_label
Draws annotations to points on timeline, change `geom_timeline_label()`. It selects highest `n_max` magnitude instances dynamically.

```{r label_plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
clean_data %>% 
  filter(COUNTRY %in% c("USA", "CHINA"), YEAR >= 2010) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = DATE, y = COUNTRY, size = EQ_PRIMARY, color = TOTAL_DEATHS)) +
  geom_timeline() +
  geom_timeline_label(aes(label = LOCATION_NAME, magnitude = EQ_PRIMARY), n_max = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Interactive Map Leaflet Plotting

Make spatial elements using `eq_map()`. Use it with `eq_create_label()` to make popup tags.

```{r map_plot, eval = FALSE}
# Generates interactive map
clean_data %>% 
  filter(COUNTRY == "MEXICO" & YEAR >= 2000) %>% 
  mutate(popup_text = eq_create_label(.)) %>% 
  eq_map(annot_col = "popup_text")
```
